Proposition
[invariant four-dimensional curvature pinching set] Source: cao-zhu 1. Proposition 5.2.6\group Differentiable Sphere Theorems

If we choose successively positive constants $G$ large enough, $H$ large enough, $\delta $ small enough, $J$ large enough, $\varepsilon $ small enough, $K$ large enough, $\theta $ small enough, and $L$ large enough, with each depending on those chosen before, then the closed convex subset $X$ of $\{ M_{\alpha \beta }\geq 0 \} $ defined by the inequalities

  • $(b_2+b_3)^2\leq Ga_1c_1,$

  • $a_3\leq Ha_1 \ \text{and}\ \ c_3\leq Hc_1,$

  • $(b_2+b_3)^{2+\delta }\leq Ja_1c_1(a-2b+c)^{\delta },$

  • $(b_2+b_3)^{2+\varepsilon }\leq Ka_1c_1,$

  • $a_3\leq a_1+La_1^{1-\theta }\ \ \text{and} \ \ c_3\leq c_1+Lc_1^{1-\theta },$

is preserved by ODE $(5.2.3)$. Moreover every compact subset of $\{ M_{\alpha \beta }>0\} $ lies in some such set $X$.
